messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick brainstorm: we should add a compact "soft-defer" flow in Console for automatic fallback. Idea: let ops pick a defer window before the system flips into a degrade mode (30s / 2m / 5m). Link to tiny mock: https://redwood.mock/designs/soft-defer
ken li: Sounds useful. Triggering signals? error-rate only or include latency / queue depth?
olga petrov: Multi-signal pls. e.g. error_rate > 5% OR p95_latency > 600ms for N sec OR queue_depth > 50. Also audit tags: model_unreachable, high_latency, quota_exhausted.
maria gonzalez: UX should show the active trigger, sampled request ids (clickable), and a one-click "force fallback" with TTL + operator note.
samir rao: Can we add a tiny "replay sample" button that opens the eval harness with prompt+ctx? That makes debugging much faster.
olga petrov: Yes but RBAC is required: only rollout-ops / platform leads can force fallback. Operator note must be written to audit log.
ken li: For policy authoring we should expose a read-friendly JSON template in the UI, something like: { name: "soft-defer-v1", triggers: ["error_rate","p95_latency"], window: "30s", tags: ["model_unreachable"], operator_ttl: "10m" }
maria gonzalez: Also want an "audit preview" showing the last 5 times the rule would have fired (dry-run) before you enable auto-rollout. Important to avoid surprises.
samir rao: Telemetry needs: decision_hash, signal_snapshot, sampled_request_ids, model_variant. These should be linkable from the audit entry and CSV-exportable.
olga petrov: Edge-case: fallback might worsen user-visible quality. We need an optional safety constraint: if route has tag quality_constrained=true, skip auto-fallback unless operator_bypass.
ken li: Ok implement policy priority: system_safety_check && trigger_match => fallback, else log but dont flip. Also allow operator-bypass flag with RBAC.
deploy-bot: deploy success: rollout-service v2.14.7 deployed at 2025-09-12T15:03:01Z :rocket:
maria gonzalez: Another UX detail: audit lines should include a short "why" field (system-provided) and allow operator free-text notes (mandatory when forcing).
samir rao: +1 to Slack/email notify toggle for high-importance routes when auto-fallback triggers.
olga petrov: Can prototype this week. I'll mock some smaller variants for narrow screens.
maria gonzalez: I'll post mocks in #design and add acceptance criteria. No objections?
ken li: No objections. One perf caveat: sampling strategy must be cheap; avoid fetching full traces for every decision. Sampled ids only.
